question: Which of the following entities is NOT a sexually transmitted disease caused by Chlamydia trachomatis?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Perihepatitis -> Not caused by Chlamydia trachomatis -> 95% CHAIN: Urethritis -> Can be caused by Chlamydia trachomatis -> 90% CHAIN: Chancroid -> Not caused by Chlamydia trachomatis -> 95% CHAIN: Lymphogranuloma venereum -> Caused by Chlamydia trachomatis -> 95%
analysis: Chlamydia trachomatis is not known to cause Chancroid. Chancroid is primarily caused by Haemophilus ducreyi, a different bacterium.
